title: vip_symbol_index
description: GENERATED artifact for the asset-processing table's row 13 ('VIP source -> NOT loaded into context, only symbol-indexed (class/method names + file:line) -> targeted read when needed'). Produced by dv_harness/vip_symbol_index.py. The defining constraint, enforced in code and asserted by a real test: this index stores DECLARATIONS AND LOCATIONS ONLY -- a class name, its base class, its method signatures, its config field names, and the file:line each was found at. It never stores a method body, a statement, or any implementation text. That is what makes it safe to hold in context while CLAUDE.md's context-budget tier 1 (NEVER-VIP-SOURCE) still denies reading the VIP source itself: the index answers 'what exists and where', and the answer to 'what does it do' is a targeted Read of the cited file:line, one method at a time, exempted deliberately rather than by loading the tree.

protocol.description: The protocol this VIP implements, supplied by the caller -- never inferred from a directory name.

roots.description: The VIP source roots that were scanned.

bytes_scanned.description: Total source bytes read to build the index. Recorded so the compression ratio against the index's own size is a real, checkable number rather than a claim.

base_class.description: The `extends` target, when declared. Real inheritance evidence -- this is how a caller finds the sequence/driver/config base a VIP class actually derives from, without reading the file.

line.description: 1-indexed declaration line, so a targeted read can jump straight here.

config_fields.description: Class properties declared `rand`/`bit`/`int`/`string`/etc at class scope -- the candidate config knobs of a VIP config object. Name, type and location only; never a default value expression, which would be implementation text.

arguments.description: The literal argument list text as declared, so a caller knows the signature without opening the file. This is a DECLARATION, not a body.
